headlines.title_en: Wallstreetcn Morning Brief | October 13, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Optimistic earnings-season expectations intertwined with Middle East risks, with the three major US stock indexes closing mixed and memory chip stocks sharply lower; oil prices rose and gold fell. China's Ministry of Finance: starting April 1, 2027, the VAT export tax rebate rate for new energy vehicles will be lowered from 13% to 9%, while export tax rebates for products such as e-cigarette devices will also be canceled. China's Ministry of Commerce said the China-EU hybrid vehicle trade arrangement will not specifically target Chinese products, and China's quota will be no lower than that of any other EU import source. Trump said both Russia and Ukraine have violated the energy ceasefire arrangement. Saudi Arabia faces a new round of drone and cruise missile attacks, and multiple empty supertankers avoided the Persian Gulf. The Nobel Prize in Economics was announced: two scholars reinterpreted Keynesian theory, laying a microeconomic foundation for macroeconomic stabilization policy. AI computing power demand exploded, and Lianxun Instruments preliminarily expects net profit for the first three quarters to increase 1866% to 2073% year on year.

headlines.title: 年内资本投入或超500亿元，券商国际化抢滩中东中亚
headlines.summary: 中资券商“出海”正从零星试探转向集中加码，年内境外子公司增资规模已突破500亿元，中东、中亚等地区成为新的战略支点。近期，中资券商国际化布局动作频频。国联民生证券20亿元增资香港子公司正式获中国证监会无异议复函，中信建投国际拿下迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）牌照，国泰君安国际与哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图市政府签署合作备忘录——一系列动作标志着券商全球化布局正从香港枢纽向中东、中亚纵深延伸。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Annual capital investment may exceed 50 billion yuan, brokerages race to expand into Middle East and Central Asia
headlines.summary_en: Chinese securities firms' 'going global' is shifting from scattered exploration to concentrated expansion, with capital increases to overseas subsidiaries already exceeding 50 billion yuan this year, and the Middle East and Central Asia becoming new strategic pivots. Recently, Chinese securities firms have made frequent moves in international expansion. Guolian Minsheng Securities' 2 billion yuan capital increase for its Hong Kong subsidiary officially received a no-objection reply letter from the CSRC, China Securities International obtained a Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) license, and Guotai Junan International signed a memorandum of cooperation with the Almaty city government in Kazakhstan - a series of moves marking that securities firms' global layout is extending from the Hong Kong hub deeper into the Middle East and Central Asia. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 上海二手房单日网签成交再破1600套，业内预判“银十”将延续修复态势
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月13日讯，上海市房地产交易中心官网“网上房地产”数据显示，10月11日（周日），上海二手房（含商业）单日网签成交1615套，刷新2026年下半年单日成交新高。这也是今年上海二手房第三次单日网签突破1600套，仅次于5月10日1664套、4月11日1632套的年内高点。综合市场数据与政策效应，业内普遍认为，上海楼市“银十”将延续稳步修复、结构分化的行情。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai second-hand home online signing deals surpass 1,600 units in a single day again, industry expects "Silver October" to continue recovery momentum
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 13: According to data from the Shanghai Real Estate Trading Center's official website 'Online Real Estate,' on October 11 (Sunday), Shanghai's second-hand homes (including commercial) recorded 1,615 online signed transactions in a single day, setting a new single-day high for the second half of 2026. This is also the third time this year that Shanghai's second-hand home online signings have exceeded 1,600 in a single day, second only to the year's highs of 1,664 on May 10 and 1,632 on April 11. Based on market data and policy effects, the industry widely believes that Shanghai's property market 'Silver October' will continue a trend of steady repair and structural divergence.

headlines.title: 年内A股市场已有21家公司完成摘牌退市
headlines.summary: 截至10月12日，年内A股市场已有21家公司完成摘牌退市，类型覆盖财务型退市、重大违法强制退市、交易型退市、主动退市等多种情形。其中，财务型退市13家、重大违法强制退市4家，两者合计占比超过八成。常态化、多元化的退市机制正在重塑资本市场生态。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: 21 companies have completed delisting from A-shares so far this year
headlines.summary_en: As of October 12, 21 companies in the A-share market have completed delisting this year, covering various types including financial delisting, mandatory delisting for major violations, trading-based delisting, and voluntary delisting. Among them, there were 13 financial delistings and 4 mandatory delistings for major violations, together accounting for more than 80%. A normalized and diversified delisting mechanism is reshaping the capital market ecosystem. (Securities Daily)

headlines.summary_en: In the first three quarters of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China issued nearly 1 trillion yuan in new loans to the foreign trade sector, up 9% year on year, with nearly 40% directed toward stabilizing foreign trade entities and foreign trade industrial chains. It focused on supporting traditional trade and new forms and models, helping develop digital trade and green trade. (CCTV)

headlines.summary: 多家中国车企的固态电池研发业务进程正在提速。10月12日，奇瑞汽车有关负责人确认，公司电池事业部的固态电池研发已在稳妥推进中。10月8日，奇瑞汽车集中发布多项2026年固态电池设备采购项目，涵盖固态电池研发、制备、检测等核心环节。不仅是奇瑞汽车，记者采访获悉，比亚迪、上汽集团、东风汽车等国内主流有新能源业务的车企集团近期都在抓紧固态电池的研发工作。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Chery Automobile, BYD, SAIC Motor and others are stepping up R&D as solid-state batteries accelerate their 'installation on vehicles'
headlines.summary_en: The solid-state battery R&D businesses of multiple Chinese automakers are accelerating. On October 12, a relevant person in charge of Chery Automobile confirmed that the company's Battery Business Unit's solid-state battery R&D is being steadily advanced. On October 8, Chery Automobile intensively released multiple 2026 solid-state battery equipment procurement projects, covering core links such as solid-state battery R&D, preparation, and testing. Not only Chery Automobile, the reporter learned from interviews that BYD, SAIC Motor, Dongfeng Motor, and other mainstream domestic automaker groups with new energy businesses have recently been stepping up solid-state battery R&D work. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 多家PCB产业链上市公司前三季度业绩预喜
headlines.summary: A股PCB（印制电路板）板块迎来密集业绩预告披露期。Wind数据显示，截至10月12日，共有6家PCB产业链上市公司先后发布2026年前三季度或第三季度业绩预告，记者梳理发现，上述公司今年前三季度归母净利润均预计实现较大幅度的同比增长。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple PCB supply chain listed companies forecast positive Q1-Q3 earnings
headlines.summary_en: The A-share PCB (printed circuit board) sector has entered a period of intensive earnings forecast disclosures. Wind data shows that as of October 12, a total of 6 listed companies in the PCB industrial chain had successively released earnings forecasts for the first three quarters or third quarter of 2026. A review by the reporter found that all of the above companies are expected to achieve relatively large year-on-year increases in net profit attributable to parent companies for the first three quarters of this year. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 攻守兼备特性凸显，红利基金总规模快速增长
headlines.summary: 近期，A股市场震荡分化，热点板块轮动加速。在此背景下，兼具抗跌韧性与估值修复潜力的红利资产，凭借攻守兼备的特性，成为各路资金重点布局的优质赛道。Wind数据显示，截至10月12日，全市场红利基金总规模突破4200亿元，达4228.07亿元，较去年同期增长20.58%；年内新成立的相关产品合计54只。资金持续涌入、机构密集推新，共同推动红利基金总规模稳步抬升。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Dividend funds' total scale grows rapidly as offensive-defensive characteristics stand out
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the A-share market has been fluctuating and diverging, with accelerated rotation among hot sectors. Against this backdrop, dividend assets, which combine downside resilience and valuation repair potential, have become a high-quality track for key allocation by various funds due to their dual offensive-defensive characteristics. Wind data shows that as of October 12, the total scale of dividend funds across the market exceeded 420 billion yuan, reaching 422.807 billion yuan, up 20.58% from the same period last year; a total of 54 related products were newly established during the year. Continuous inflows of funds and intensive launches by institutions have jointly driven the total scale of dividend funds steadily higher. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 年内多家保险机构密集披露增资计划
headlines.summary: 根据中国保险行业协会披露信息统计发现，9月以来，已有5家险企披露增资计划。今年前三季度，共有13家中小型保险机构（包括人身险公司、财险公司和再保险公司）披露增资计划，计划注册资本增加规模合计约134亿元。受访专家表示，多家险企近期披露增资计划，主要受低利率环境、新会计准则实施、行业业务结构转型等因素影响。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple insurance institutions密集 disclose capital increase plans during the year
headlines.summary_en: According to statistics from information disclosed by the Insurance Association of China, since September, 5 insurers have disclosed capital increase plans. In the first three quarters of this year, a total of 13 small and medium-sized insurance institutions (including life insurers, property insurers, and reinsurers) disclosed capital increase plans, with a planned total increase in registered capital of about 13.4 billion yuan. Experts interviewed said that the recent capital increase plans disclosed by multiple insurers are mainly affected by factors such as the low interest rate environment, the implementation of new accounting standards, and the transformation of the industry's business structure. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 多元资产配置打开新空间，今年以来FOF新发规模近1500亿元
headlines.summary: FOF正在迎来前所未有的扩容周期，年内新成立FOF产品超过150只，募集规模近1500亿元，产品数量、发行规模双双刷新年度纪录。从业内最新动向看，当前还有超过30只FOF正在或即将发行，仅10月12日就有12只FOF集中发行。从制度导向看，FOF也迎来制度发展红利，FOF成立门槛或将从2亿元降低至5000万元，还被允许投资ETF联接基金，更好发挥资产配置功能。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Diversified asset allocation opens up new space, with new FOF issuance scale nearing 150 billion yuan so far this year
headlines.summary_en: FOFs are entering an unprecedented expansion cycle, with more than 150 FOF products newly established during the year, raising nearly 150 billion yuan, with both the number of products and issuance scale setting annual records. Based on the latest trends in the industry, more than 30 FOFs are currently being or about to be issued, with 12 FOFs centrally issued on October 12 alone. From an institutional perspective, FOFs are also benefiting from institutional development dividends: the threshold for establishing a FOF may be lowered from 200 million yuan to 50 million yuan, and they will also be allowed to invest in ETF feeder funds, better leveraging their asset allocation function. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 10月13日午间新闻精选
headlines.summary: 【10月13日午间新闻精选】1、截至午间收盘，上证指数跌0.27%，深证成指跌0.78%，创业板指跌0.95%。2、港股午间收盘，恒生指数跌0.39%，恒生科技指数跌1.54%。3、多家硅料企业联合召开闭门会，约定平均成本含税价不低于每吨4.3万元。4、IMF预测2026年全球实际GDP增长率为3.1%（7月预测值为3.0%），主要原因为关键经济体的AI投资缓和了能源价格冲击的影响。IMF预测2027年全球经济增长率为3.4%，与7月预测持平（2025年实际增长率为3.5%）。5、韩国KOSPI指数跌幅扩大至7%，SK海力士跌超9%，三星电子跌逾8%。

headlines.title_en: Midday News Highlights for October 13
headlines.summary_en: [October 13 Midday News Highlights] 1. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.27%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.78%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.95%. 2. At the Hong Kong midday close, the Hang Seng Index fell 0.39%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.54%. 3. Several polysilicon companies jointly held a closed-door meeting and agreed that the average cost, including tax, should be no less than 43,000 yuan per ton. 4. The IMF forecasts global real GDP growth of 3.1% in 2026 (July forecast: 3.0%), mainly because AI investment in key economies eased the impact of energy price shocks. The IMF forecasts global economic growth of 3.4% in 2027, unchanged from its July forecast (actual growth in 2025 was 3.5%). 5. South Korea's KOSPI index extended its decline to 7%, SK Hynix fell more than 9%, and Samsung Electronics fell more than 8%.
